full_judgment:
Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 8572 of 2014 discharging the Rule. 

 3. Facts necessary to dispose this petition are that Nazma Zahir (Shova), elder sister of the informant and Jahirul Islam son of late Abdul Rashid Munshi (written in the FIR as a A Majid Munshi) got married 30 years back and since their marriage they used to live in their own residence in Dhaka. The informant's sister's husband Jahirul Islam is the Sub Division Engineer of Bridge Project under the Ministry of Food and Disaster Management. On 05.02.2010, the sister of the informant and her husband went to Barisal and stayed at a V.I.P room at the 5th Floor of the Hotel Ali international. Keeping her sister in the Hotel, her brother-in-law used to go of different districts/upazillas for inspection of the progress of the works every day and after inspection used to return to the Hotel. On 15.02.2010 at about 04.50 a.m. Jahirul Islam went to Amtali Upazilla under Barguna District. At about 9.00 house he told Ruma Ahmed, another sister of the informant over phone to go to the Hotel as his wife was not receiving his phone call. Then Ruma Ahmed went to that Hotel at about 9.00 a.m. and called her sister and knocked the door repeatedly but she did not open the door. Then she took the duplicate key of the room from the manager and after opening the door she found that her sister was killed by cutting her throat. Then she informed her relatives over cell phone. The hotel authority informed the police of the matter. The informant suspects that her sister's husband Jahirul Islam son of late A. Rashid Munshi might be involved in the killing of her sister and hence, the case. 

 4. On receipt of the FIR police took up investigation of the case and after investigation prima-facie case having been made out against the accused-petitioner and Abdul Malek submitted Charge Sheet No.150 dated 14.04.2010 under sections 302/109 of the Penal Code against them, After submission of charge sheet the case being ready for trial was transmitted to the learned Metropolitan Session Judge, Barisal for holding trial and the case was numbered as Session Case No. 192 of 2010. Thereafter, the case record was transmitted to the Druta Bichar Tribunal, Barisal for disposal which was registered as Druto Bichar Case No. 6 of 2010. 

 5. On the other hand. One Nazia Zahir daughter of the victim, filed a complaint petition over the self-same occurrence in the Court of the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, 2nd Cognizance Court, Barisal which was sent to the Kotwali Police Station, Barisal for recording the same as a First Information Report and accordingly, Kotwali Model P.S. Case No. 50 dated 27.07.2010 corresponding to G.R. No. 558 of 2010 (Sadar) was started under section 302/34 of the Penal Code against 5 accused-persons including the informant of the earlier case. The prosecution story of the said Kotwali Model P.S. Case No. 50 dated 27.07.2010, in short, is that the complaint is the only daughter of the deceased Nazma Zahir. The accused Nos. 1 and 3 are her mother's sister and the accused Nos. 2 and 4 are their husbands complainant lives in Australia. On 15.02.2010 she came to know from her friend Borsha over cell phone that her mother was killed at Hotel Ali International in Barishal. She went to Barisal as soon as possible and communicated with the accused Nos. 1-4 but they seriously avoided her and misbehaved with her and she came to know that the accused No. 1 lodged a case against her father. Then she made communication with the Investigating Officer. But he also avoided her and did not even take her statement. She came to know that on 15.02.2010 at about 5.15 a.m., the accused-persons went to the Hotel to her mother. The accused Nos. 1-4 used to give tremendous pressure upon the mother of the informant to transfer her 62 decimals land situated behind the Post Officer of Jhalokathi Town in their names and she having refused, they killed her and left the place with the ornaments of the deceased worth Tk. 1,00,000/-. The conjugal life of the father and the mother of the complaint was very happy. The complainant firmly believes that being greedy to get the landed property, money and flat of her mother, the accused-persons killed her mother by cutting her throat. 

 6. The Investigation Officer after investigation submitted Charge Sheet No. 594 dated 12.11.2013 under section 302 of the Penal Code against accused Md. Jahirul Haque Shohel son of Fazlul Hoq Khalifa and also submit-ted final report in favour of other FIR named accused-persons. The learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, 2nd Cognizance Court, Barisal by order dated 09.12.2013 accepted the Charge Sheet No. 594 dated 12.11.2013 of Kotwali Model P.S. Barisal against the said accused Md. Jahirul Haque Shohel and transmitted the case record to the Sessions Judge, Barisal for holding trial. 

 7. As against that the proceedings of Druta Bichar Case No. 06 of 2010 arising out of Kotwali P.S. Case No. 47 dated 15.02.2010 the accused-petitioner filed Miscellaneous Case No. 8572 of 2014 under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashment of the proceedings and obtained Rule. A Division Bench of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order discharged the Rule. Hence the accused-petitioner filed this petition for leave to appeal. 

 9. Out of the self same occurrence two cases have been initiated, one pursuant to FIR dated 15.02.2010 lodged by Nilufar Irin Jhumu, sister of the victim Nazma Zahir giving rise to Barishal Kotwali P.S. Case No. 47, dated 15.02.2010, corresponding to G.R. No. 125 of 2010, and the case was in due course registered as Druto Bichar Tribunal Case No. 6 of 2010 under section 302/34 of the Penal Code. On the other hand the daughter of the victim, Nazia Zahir lodged Complaint Case No. 279 of 2010 dated 27.07.2010 giving rise to Barishal, Kotwali P.S. Case No. 50 dated 27.07.2010 corresponding to G.R. No. 558 of 2010 which was in due course registered as Sessions Case No. 53 of 2014. In the complaint case, the informant of Barishal, Kotwali P.S. Case No. 47 of 2010 (Druto Bichar Case No. 6 of 2010) and her husband Jahirul Haque Sohel stand as accused. After investigation charge sheet was submitted against accused Md. Jahirul Hoque Shohel only while final report was submitted in respect of the other accused named in the FIR. 

 10. Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 8572 of 2014 was filed by Md. Jahirul Islam (husband of the victim) accused in Druto Bichar Tribunal Case No. 6 of 2010 with a prayer for quashing the proceeding of the Druto Bichar Tribunal Case No. 06 of 2010. The Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7357 of 2014 was filed by Md. Jahirul Haque Sohel (brother-in-law of the victim) who stands accused in Sessions Case No. 53 of 2010 with a prayer for transferring the Sessions Case to the Court of Druto Bichar Tribunal, Barishal to hold the trial along with Druto Bichar Tribunal Case No. 06 of 2010. When the Rule was issued in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 8572 of 2014 filed by Md. Jahirul Islam (husband of the victim) the Court directed that the Rule would be heard along with the Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7357 of 2014. It appears that in due course the Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 8572 of 2014 was heard without any mention of the Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7357 of 2014. 

 11. Having considered the submissions of the learned Advocate and on perusal of the materials placed before us, we are of the opinion that the ends justice would be met of both the cases are heard simultaneously by one Court. Accordingly, we hereby direct that the Sessions Case No. 53 of 2014 be transferred to the Druto Bichar Tribunal, Barisal to be heard simultaneously with Druto Bichar Tribunal Case No. 6 of 2010. 

 12. In view of our decision above, the Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7357 of 2014 filed with a prayer for simultaneous hearing has become in fructuous. 

 13. Accordingly, the Rule in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 7357 of 2014 is disposed of.
